title: astronomy — attain

sentences.sentence: Do you know anything about astronomy?
sentences.translation: 你懂天文学吗?

sentences.sentence: In both cases, these insights come not from the science of astronomy but from atmospherics — and that's not really so surprising.
sentences.translation: 两种情形下，这些见解并非来自于天文学，而是来自大气干扰—— 而且，那并不令人感到如此的吃惊。

sentences.sentence: But exactly what cut through the haze has been one of the big questions in astrophysics.
sentences.translation: 然而，究竟是什么驱散了烟雾？ 这一直是天体物理学上的一个重大问题之一。

sentences.sentence: So for decades, astronomers have used it as a “standard candle” in the field of high-energy astrophysics.
sentences.translation: 因此几十年来，天文学家一直将其视为高能天体物理领域的“标准烛光”使用。

sentences.sentence: Unless your physics specialty is deeply theoretical or has to do with astrophysics, you can usually find an industry job that is related to your work.
sentences.translation: 除非你的物理学专业极端理论化，或者是天体物理，否则你通常是可以在工业界找到一个相关的职位的。

sentences.sentence: Well, unless you have an asymmetric set-up, in which case the client can POST and/or PUT its order somewhere on the server.
sentences.translation: 那么，除非你有一个不对称的设置，在这种情况下，客户端可以POST和/或PUT它的订单到服务器的某处。

sentences.sentence: Whereas the traditional ER model has an even and balanced style of entities and complex relationships among entities, the star model is very asymmetric.
sentences.translation: 传统的 ER 模型具有均匀且平衡的实体样式和实体之间的复杂关系，而星型模型却是完全不对称的。

sentences.sentence: But it also has drawbacks, including the performance overhead of asymmetric encryption and the management headaches of obtaining and maintaining certificates for each client.
sentences.translation: 但是它也有缺点，包括不对称加密的性能开销和每个客户端获取和维护证书的繁琐管理。

astronomy
音标：英 /ə'strɒnəmɪ/  美 /ə'strɑnəmi/
n. 天文学

例句：In both cases, these insights come not from the science of astronomy but from atmospherics — and that's not really so surprising.
两种情形下，这些见解并非来自于天文学，而是来自大气干扰—— 而且，那并不令人感到如此的吃惊。

astrophysics
音标：英 /æstrə(ʊ)'fɪzɪks/  美 /,æstro'fɪzɪks/
n. 天体物理学

例句：So for decades, astronomers have used it as a “standard candle” in the field of high-energy astrophysics.
因此几十年来，天文学家一直将其视为高能天体物理领域的“标准烛光”使用。
例句：Unless your physics specialty is deeply theoretical or has to do with astrophysics, you can usually find an industry job that is related to your work.
除非你的物理学专业极端理论化，或者是天体物理，否则你通常是可以在工业界找到一个相关的职位的。

asymmetric
音标：英 /,æsɪ'metrɪk/  美 /,esɪ'mɛtrɪk/

例句：But it also has drawbacks, including the performance overhead of asymmetric encryption and the management headaches of obtaining and maintaining certificates for each client.
但是它也有缺点，包括不对称加密的性能开销和每个客户端获取和维护证书的繁琐管理。
